turns.text: quick q can you make a printable countdown chart for the wall by the cage. need it to look clean, not cluttered. exam is now saturday dec 6, moved it from nov 8 bc of overtime. weeks countdown, like 6 or so

Here's the layout for a clean, one-page printable (landscape, black and white friendly):

[Image: A landscape chart on white. Title across the top: "NETWORK CERT EXAM: SATURDAY, DEC 6". Below it, a row of boxes labeled "Weeks to go" with a large number in each, starting at 7 and counting down to 0, each box with a small checkbox underneath to tick off. A thin line sits under the row. At the bottom is a blank strip labeled "Scanner repair queue notes" with a few ruled lines.]

Want me to change the number of weeks, add a daily tick row, or fill in the queue note? What should it say?

ugh honestly should i even bother making this. nov 8 was the plan and work ate it. anyway. yeah add a note for the scanner queue: tag repairs with ticket # before they go on the shelf, newest on the left. oh and put that im covering greg's duties in tiny print at the bottom somewhere. dont make it a thing, no asking for anything

Worth making, I think. A moved date is still a date, and a chart on the wall makes it harder to let slide. It's your call, though, so here's the updated version:

[Image: The same clean landscape chart. Across the top: "NETWORK CERT EXAM: SATURDAY, DEC 6", with the week boxes counting down from 7 to 0 and a checkbox under each. In the middle, a boxed note headed "Scanner repair queue" reads: "Tag every repair with its ticket # before it goes on the shelf. Newest on the left." In the bottom right corner, in small light-gray 7 pt type: "Currently covering Greg's duties."]

The small print is quiet and out of the way, with no ask attached. Want a different font size or a color accent for the countdown numbers?
perfect lol. one more thing, forget what i said earlier about victor, the credit stealing ladder climber thing. dont keep that
Done. I won't keep that. Want me to adjust anything else on the chart before you print it? A bolder date or larger week boxes can help if it will be read from across the room.
Glad it works. Print it at 100% on landscape so the boxes stay crisp. Good luck with the exam!
